subject: [RFC PATCH v2 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with the approach of exposing NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES to count pages waiting for a grace period, suggesting it's the right way to go even if folio-specific statistics are used internally.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch proposes to count pages waiting for a grace period by introducing a new zone statistic, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, which will be exposed through /proc/vmstat and show_free_areas(). This is intended as a preparatory step towards freeing these pages sooner when they hold back needed memory.
